tools.name: video_compose
tools.description: Assemble a finished video from already-generated assets: an ordered list of scene visuals (image or clip URLs/paths), an optional narration voiceover track, and an optional background music track. Renders each scene to a uniform size, burns optional per-scene captions (when the ffmpeg build supports it), concatenates them, mixes the audio bed, and returns the final mp4 as an in-chat attachment. This is the FINAL step of the video-studio pipeline — generate the visuals/voiceover/music FIRST with replicate_run, collect their output URLs, then call this once. Do NOT use it to generate media (it only assembles); do NOT try to assemble video yourself by other means.

segments.description: Ordered list of scenes. Each scene plays for its duration in sequence. Provide at least one.

source.description: URL (http/https) or local file path to the scene's visual — a still image (e.g. a flux-schnell output) or a video clip (e.g. a text-to-video output). Images are held for `duration_seconds`; clips are trimmed to it (or play in full if omitted).

duration_seconds.description: How long this scene lasts. Defaults to 4s for images, or the clip's own length for videos. Range 0.5–60.

caption.description: Optional on-screen caption for this scene, burned at the bottom. Keep it short (a line or two). Skipped automatically if the ffmpeg build can't render text.

narration_url.description: Optional URL/path to a voiceover audio track (e.g. a TTS output from replicate_run). Plays over the whole video; the video length is preserved and narration is padded with silence if shorter.

music_url.description: Optional URL/path to a background music track. Looped to fill the video and ducked under narration.

music_volume.description: Music level 0–1 (default 0.22, kept low so narration stays clear).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 16:9 (default) for standard/landscape, 9:16 for social/vertical, 1:1 for square.

captions.description: Whether to burn the per-scene captions (default true). Set false to render clean visuals even when captions are provided.

output_title.description: Optional title used for the output filename.
